title: Affine Bernstein rigidity through dimension nine and a smooth dimension-ten counterexample

result.label: Affine Bernstein rigidity through dimension nine and a smooth dimension-ten counterexample
result.statement: Proves that every smooth locally uniformly convex affine-maximal graph of dimension three through nine, complete for its induced Euclidean metric, is an elliptic paraboloid. A smooth entire nonquadratic example in dimension ten makes this range sharp. In dimensions three through nine, the paraboloid classification also holds for connected open locally uniformly convex affine-maximal hypersurfaces complete for the affine Berwald–Blaschke metric.
